intro.caption: Product Owners face two questions every sprint: were our stories ready, and did we stick to what we committed?

answer.caption: Sprintwise answers both. Paste a story, upload a CSV, or connect Jira Cloud.
answer.spoken: Sprintwise answers both. Paste a story, upload a C.S.V., or connect Jira Cloud.

aiDraft.caption: It also spots signs of an AI draft nobody re-read, like chat leftovers and criteria that would fit any story.
aiDraft.spoken: It also spots signs of an A.I. draft nobody re-read, like chat leftovers, and criteria that would fit any story.

rules.caption: Nine fixed rules score every story out of 100, with a reason for every point lost. The weakest come first.
rules.spoken: Nine fixed rules score every story out of a hundred, with a reason for every point lost. The weakest come first.

weak.caption: This one uses vague words like 'fast' and 'easy', and states no benefit, so it scores 50.

noAi.caption: No AI sets the score. In a project, the same story always gets the same number.
noAi.spoken: No A.I. sets the score. In a project, the same story always gets the same number.

tryIt.caption: Try your own. A vague one-line story scores low…
tryIt.spoken: Try your own. A vague, one-line story scores low.

climbs.caption: …and the score climbs as it gets clear.
climbs.spoken: And the score climbs as it gets clearer.

baseline.caption: On day one, the team locks a baseline. Every later change is compared against it.

metrics.caption: Here scope grew 18.8%, churn was 50%, and only 37.5% of the commitment was done.
metrics.spoken: Here, scope grew eighteen point eight percent, churn was fifty percent, and only thirty-seven and a half percent of the commitment was done.

finding.caption: The stories that changed scored 40 points lower before planning.

trends.caption: Across sprints, trends show velocity, churn and completion.

report.caption: Each sprint fits on one printable page for the retrospective, with a burn-up of scope against work done.

jira.caption: Signed in, you can import straight from a Jira search, and send edits back. Sprintwise writes to Jira only when you click Send.

refine.caption: Refinement takes the team through one story at a time: read it, fix what's missing, agree a size.

share.caption: Share a read-only backlog or report with the team, no account needed.

planning.caption: When planning, Sprintwise shows how many points the team usually finishes, from the last three sprints.

start.caption: Try the demo without an account, or sign in with GitHub to use it on your own backlog. It's free.

close.caption: Sprintwise: sprintwise-omega.vercel.app
close.spoken: Sprintwise. Free to use, at sprintwise omega dot vercel dot app.
